outcome: Windows machines are first-class harness hosts with zero user setup: every registered hook resolves through the forge launcher and BLOCKS (exit 2) instead of silently disarming when anything in its chain is missing; cmd/PowerShell users get a native forge.cmd that only trusts real executables (an argument-injection class was found and eliminated in review); doctor executes all eight registered hook commands verbatim and names exactly what is broken; recorders and the delegation lock work on Windows (lazy fcntl, msvcrt); CRLF and cp1252 encodings can no longer corrupt the launcher or crash output; and a windows-latest CI job now proves the armed lockout path on every PR. New clients get all of it at init; existing clients on their next forge upgrade.
